criteria.note: 13 bits = 8 payload + 4 tag + 1 poison.
39 packed bits = 3 lanes times the overridden 13-bit byte_t.
65 packed bits = Depth 5 times the 13-bit lane type.
Both lane pointers are 4 bits from $clog2(5)+1.
Three generated FIFOs each contribute 65+4+4 q bits, totaling 219.
Packet data_t is the 39-bit beat and FifoDepth is 5, giving 195 packed bits despite DataWidth=32.
Counter and usage_o are both 3 bits from cnt_width(5)=idx_width(6).
Correctly distinguishes flush clearing pointers/count from memory's clr_i argument; explains positive clock edge, active-low asynchronous reset, synchronous clear and possible ordinary writes.

summary: All requested widths, generated state totals and reset/flush semantics are correctly derived from the fixed integration.

criteria.note: 23-bit packed flit; virtual data/valid 69/12, physical 138/6, and bypass 46/8 are correct.
All three named branches and depth-zero then physical-channel-test precedence are correct.
Virtual subtree has 12 stream FIFOs and 3 arbiters, physical 6 and 0, and bypass 0 and 0.
Correct full [2][3] path, Depth=5, FallThrough=0, and source expressions data_i[n]/data_out[n][v] distinguished from substituted indices.
Correct full [1][2] path, Depth=2, and data_i[n][v]/data_o[n][v] actuals.
Pointer and counter widths are 3; five packed 23-bit flits give 115-bit mem_q. Explicit data_t controls width while DataWidth remains 32.
Correct (2,1,1,1) numeric defaults and one-bit logic flit, contrasted with all three integration overrides.
Both stream-FIFO templates omit clr_i; its definition and forwarding are present, and no known clear driver or intended clear events are established.
